queries.query: Kipushi Democratic Republic of the Congo cadastral map parcel cadastre official
queries.result: The official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs directory was found and lists Kipushi-Nord and Kipushi-Sud under Haut-Katanga. The BIC public cadastral platform was also found, but it advertises digital parcel coverage only for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu; no public Kipushi parcel geometry endpoint was evidenced.

queries.query: RDC Kipushi cadastre parcelles carte cadastrale service officiel
queries.result: La recherche a confirmé les circonscriptions foncières de Kipushi-Nord et Kipushi-Sud dans le Haut-Katanga. Le ministère publie une procédure de recherche foncière, mais aucune API publique anonyme de parcelles et de géométrie n'a été trouvée. Le BIC limite sa couverture annoncée au Nord-Kivu et au Sud-Kivu.

freshResearch.nativeLanguageNote: French is the official administrative language used by the DRC land/cadastre sources; a French route was therefore used for local-language discovery.

registryEvidence.custodian: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo
registryEvidence.localScope: The official directory lists Kipushi-Nord and Kipushi-Sud as Haut-Katanga land/cadastral circumscriptions.
registryEvidence.sourceType: local registry/cadastre custodian and official procedure evidence; no public parcel geometry service evidenced

sourceAssessment.coverage: The public BIC landing page advertises service availability for Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu only; Haut-Katanga/Kipushi is outside that advertised digital coverage.
safeFieldsAllowlist: stable native parcel identity if later exposed

runtimeReadinessReason: A serial reviewer must independently qualify a real adapter. No anonymous Kipushi parcel endpoint, schema, CRS, stable parcel identity, or bounded geometry response was available in this attempt.
uncertainty: The official local custodian and Kipushi circumscriptions are evidenced, but the source pages do not publish a machine-readable parcel layer.
BIC coverage limits describe that public pilot and do not prove that paper or restricted cadastral records are absent in Kipushi.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI was treated as evidence of citywide absence.
